title: LISA residual Galactic binary foreground: analysis code and numerical results
description: Analysis and plotting code, tests, and processed numerical results accompanying Ruo-Yu Guan and Yan Wang, Residual Galactic binary foreground in LISA stochastic gravitational-wave background inference: source power concentration and spectral degeneracy, accepted in Physical Review D (article DOI: 10.1103/4779-jw6l). The release includes the five figure inputs, catalog matching and power calculations, diagonal covariance and Fisher calculations, and direct binned-power moments. Original code is MIT licensed; supplied numerical results and figures are CC BY 4.0 as specified in DATA_LICENSE.md. Original Sangria and Erebor input files are not redistributed.
